{{Quote|They're called Mountaintop smugglers. Their leader is Janelle. You'll have to go fight them to get the ring back. And if you win, maybe I won't have to pay any of the rest of what I owe them.|[[Herman Pate]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" />}}
The '''Mountaintop smugglers''' were a criminal organization in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The organization primarily consisted of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] runners.<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" />

==History==
{{Quote|There were some spice smugglers I owed some money to. Janelle, their leader, seemed to really like the ring, and offered to overlook my late payments in exchange for the ring.|Herman Pate, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], they were led by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] by the name of [[Janelle]], and operated a camp in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], a short distance east of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]].<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Janelle acquired a ring from [[Herman Pate]] as a payment of a debt. The ring was a family heirloom previously lost by [[Vance Groten]] to Herman Pate during a [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] game. As Groten intended to recover his ring, he dispatched [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to find the smuggler leader. The spacers [[Death/Legends|killed]] Janelle and at least twenty-three other members at their camp.<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mountaintop smugglers appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mountaintop smugglers were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
